experiments.scope: One 8-bit modular addition; all 65536 ordered input pairs; identical three-bit XOR differences 0x15 on both addends; output XOR 0.
experiments.hypothesis: Two addends carrying the same three-bit non-adjacent, non-MSB XOR difference cancel modularly with probability exactly 2^-3 (8192 of 65536 pairs): each difference bit needs opposite signs in the two addends. This is the exact finite-width analogue of the W20, W22 and W29 message-expansion cancellations of the characteristic (identical XOR patterns of weight 3 on both operands), whose 32-bit versions are declared as sampled experiments.

experiments.scope: One 32-bit modular addition of the two active operands W9 and sigma1(W14) of the expanded word W16 = W0 + sigma0(W1) + W9 + sigma1(W14) in the 32-step characteristic; 256 organizer-seeded uniform ordered input pairs; XOR input differences exactly those of the verified pair (sigma0, sigma1 are GF(2)-linear so the operand XOR differences are fixed); output XOR 0.
experiments.hypothesis: Over uniform inputs the two signed differences cancel modularly (so the expanded word W16 is difference-free) with probability exactly 4/64 = 2^-4, the value obtained by enumerating all sign patterns of the 3+3 difference bits; the expected number of successes in 256 samples is 16. This is a local finite-sample check of one cancellation of the characteristic, not evidence about the whole trail.
